newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico City to give trolleybus concession in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Mexico City to give trolleybus concession in Nov.

text.p: The Mexico City Mayor's office will name the winner of a concession to operate 50 trolley buses in November, a city transport chief said on Tuesday.

"The ruling will be made in November. More than 15 companies qualified and tendered bids," Fernando Ramirez de Aguilar from the Mexico City Transport Commitee said. The concession is the first of several to build up the city's public transport system.
"Concessions will be awarded to run a total of 200 trolley buses over three years: 50 in 1996, 75 in 1997 and the same in 1998," he added.
-- Maria Luisa Aguilar, Mexico City newsroom +525 728-9553
